problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a specialized courier drone to service 11 distinct transmission nodes.

The flight durations between nodes are measured in minutes:
* Node Alpha to Node Beta: 79.2 min
* Node Alpha to Node Gamma: 75.1 min
* Node Alpha to Node Delta: 28.8 min
* Node Alpha to Node Epsilon: 79.2 min
* Node Alpha to Node Zeta: 80.0 min

* Node Alpha to Node Kappa: 90.9 min
* Node Alpha to Node Lambda: 28.1 min

* Node Beta to Node Zeta: 86.0 min

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient flight circuit, wherein the drone must visit every transmission node precisely once before concluding its mission at the origin node.
